capabilities: Build decision maps with options, benefits, risks, and sub-options
Rate factors on 1-5 likelihood and impact scales and compute normalized -100 to +100 scores
Mark risks as deal-breakers that block an option from being recommended
Collapse, focus, search, and dim branches while editing the map
Export decisions as Markdown reports, SVG/JPG images, PDFs, and JSON backups
extras: Full user guide lives in a separate HELP.md rather than the README. Works entirely offline with no account, AI service, or analytics.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tool for structuring a difficult decision visually, weighing benefits against risks, and explaining why one option wins.
summary: File-based visual decision map that turns a choice into options, benefits, and risks, rates them, and shows which option scores strongest.
